sentences: Let's get started with something important—our coding standards and practices.
Consistency is key in our team, and we have certain conventions that we follow to maintain a uniform code base.
This helps us quickly identify variables in our code and maintains consistency across the entire project.
From now on, I want you to make sure that all your variable names follow this format.
This will ensure that your code aligns with our team's standards and makes it easier for your colleagues to understand your work.
It's important to get comfortable with version control early on.
Make sure you have all the necessary tools installed, including our preferred Python development environment and the required libraries.
If you need any assistance, don't hesitate to reach out to me or your colleagues.
